## SCR-01 – Consignment details

**Purpose:** Capture where and when the consignment will arrive, the country of export and, for RoW countries, the CHED number.  
**Evidence basis:** Current HTML prototype in app/part1/v5/views/manual/arrival-details.html, its route and country-autocomplete script, plus the supplied stakeholder-answer fixture. No separate Figma/PDF design or original backlog was supplied. The prototype uses a hard-coded port list, omits the transport-type playback/change link, and triggers CHED for countries outside its static European set rather than an explicit RoW list. Its date check uses the server's local timezone rather than explicitly Europe/London, and the CHED route checks presence only, not the hinted format. The time hint now shows 24-hour examples before and after midday; the date hint example (27 3 2026) is in the past. Error states are evidenced by code, not a separate design artefact.  
**Backlog:** W06-02, W06-03 | ARR-01, ARR-02, ARR-03, ARR-04, ARR-05, ARR-06, SUM-08  
**Next:** –
